resources.title: Silent Hill · Xbox 360 alpha port
resources.author: SlickAmogus / Silent Hill decompilation contributors; original game by Konami
resources.description: Early native Xbox 360 port with classic or third-person camera options. It requires your own USA PlayStation disc data.
resources.prerequisites: Your own Silent Hill USA .bin disc image in the silenthill subfolder; any filename ending in .bin is accepted. Keep the complete release folder writable for logs and saves. No game image is included.
resources.runtime: BadUpdate + XeUnshackle is the publisher’s documented Xbox 360 route. Its BadUpdate entry point requires dashboard 17559; the app does not publish a separate motherboard or minimum-dashboard matrix.
resources.temporary: BadUpdate followed by XeUnshackle is explicitly documented. Re-establish that runtime after reboot. Other temporary payloads and Peer Pressure are not separately certified by this release.
setup: Extract the ZIP on your PC. Copy its Silent Hill folder to a dedicated homebrew location, or copy that folder’s contents into the shown SilentHill path; avoid nesting it twice.
Put your own USA .bin under silenthill\ beside the optional silenthill.cfg. The final executable sits one directory above the disc image.
Launch default.xex from Aurora, FreeStyle or xbGuard after the documented runtime. Preserve silenthill\save\0.MCD when updating.
resources.notes: Alpha build: busy scenes can slow down and visual/combat/save behavior has known issues. Earlier test saves can have lost inventory items; memory cards are not interchangeable with the PC port. Keep your current saves and build. No physical-console execution was performed by this site.
